description: Source file implementing the PDCP entity receive (rx) logic, including PDU handling, security, reordering, timers, and header decompression for a 5G/4G LTE protocol stack.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_rx
classes.description: Class implementing the receive side of the PDCP protocol entity, managing PDU processing, security, reordering, timers, and header decompression.

classes.name: reordering_callback
classes.description: Callback class for handling reordering timer expiration events.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::stop
methods.description: Stops the PDCP receive entity, halting timers and processing.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notifies that PDU processing has been stopped.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::end_buffering
methods.description: Ends buffering and processes buffered PDUs.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::suspend
methods.description: Suspends PDU processing, stops timers, and delivers buffered SDUs.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns an awaitable object for crypto token synchronization.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming PDU, handling buffering, security, and dispatching.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::reestablish
methods.description: Handles re-establishment of the PDCP entity, resetting state and security.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::handle_data_pdu
methods.description: Processes a data PDU, including header parsing, security, and reordering.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::apply_security
methods.description: Applies security (deciphering and integrity check) to a PDU.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::apply_deciphering_and_integrity_check
methods.description: Performs deciphering and integrity verification on a PDU.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::configure_security
methods.description: Configures security parameters and engines for the PDCP entity.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::handle_t_reordering_expire
methods.description: Handles expiration of the reordering timer, delivering SDUs accordingly.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::reordering_callback::operator()
methods.description: Callback invoked when reordering timer expires.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_rx::read_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Reads and extracts header information from a data PDU.
